inputs.text:
Don't fall for the surface-level noise they are feeding us. The official story claims that DHS arrested an illegal immigrant gang member after New York City authorities released him despite the danger he posed to public safety, and they want you to focus on the narrative of "tensions" and "public safety risks" between sanctuary policies and federal immigration enforcement. DHS even went as far as criticizing the city's actions and pointing to the potential public safety risks of releasing individuals with criminal records. 

Wake up. This is all a carefully constructed illusion. These supposed conflicts are entirely staged to make you think the system is fractured, while the hidden elites coordinate every single move behind closed doors. It is a manufactured distraction designed to invert reality and justify the expansion of federal surveillance and control grids.
